name: Online Bibles
description: Download public-domain Bible translations hosted by OpenSanctuary (or from a public GitHub repository you name) into your Bible library, and look up passages online. Licensed Bibles such as the NIV come from the YouVersion plugin.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the console
The server fetches the OpenSanctuary Bibles catalog and Bibles, a GitHub repository's Bible files, and single passages from these hosts on the plugin's behalf, and from no others
Adds the downloaded chapters to your Bible library. Downloading a translation again replaces its chapters, so this can also replace chapters of a translation you already have
Adds a looked-up passage to the schedule
